title: tc-alert-feed
description:
A live feed of alerts – category, severity, title, subject and a fresh relative time, with actions per alert,
counts in the header, Pause feed, and polite announcements of new alerts.

heading.description: The heading, and the feed's name

items.description: The alerts, in any order – shown newest first

actions.description: Every alert's actions, unless it names its own (Escalate and Acknowledge by default)

paused.description: Holds new alerts back behind a "Show N new" button. Changed by the user unless a tc-paused-change listener calls preventDefault()

now.description: "Now" for the relative times and today's count, epoch ms; unset, the element keeps its own clock

todayCount.description: The events counted today, in the header; by default the alerts given since midnight

severityLabels.description: The severities' names, merged over the defaults (Critical, High, Medium, Info)

locale.description: The language for times, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

empty.description: Shown when there are no alerts

category.description: The kind of alert, shown as a small caps tag: "Payment"

subject.description: Who or what it's about, an id and where, e.g. "Northwind Traders · ACC-4471 · Rotterdam"

source.description: Where it came from – a team, a rule, a case – as a quiet tag

acknowledged.description: Already dealt with: shown quietly, without Acknowledge

actions.description: This alert's actions, in place of `actions`

tone.description: "danger" for an action that escalates, "primary" for the main one; plain otherwise
